card.name: Letter g inside long medical words
card.fires_on: The piece of a long word that holds the sound g, such as og, oga, rag or G, when the word is split partway through. Seen in words like peptidoglycan, nasogastric, methemoglobin, supragingival and ingredients.

card.writes: It suppresses plain g-like tokens, so it seems to steer away from a bare g next, since the g is already supplied.
card.plain: It marks the spot in a long medical word where a g sound has just been spelled, as in nasogastric.
